channel_dna.platform_type: Community and interview platform for bootstrapped and independent founders. Founded by Courtland Allen, acquired by Stripe. Home of the 'build in public' movement.
channel_dna.algorithm_type: Community-driven upvotes + editorial curation. Milestone posts and transparent revenue sharing get highest engagement. Forum threads sorted by engagement.
channel_dna.primary_audience: Solo founders, indie hackers, bootstrapped SaaS founders, developers who ship products. Ages 25-45. High overlap with Hacker News but more focused on business metrics and growth.
channel_dna.native_content_formats: Forum posts (milestones, questions, product showcases), interviews (revenue-focused), podcast, newsletter. Transparent revenue numbers are the currency of the platform.
channel_dna.platform_culture_code: Radical transparency about revenue, growth, and failure. '10-minute interviews' sharing exact MRR are the most popular content. Hustle and persistence celebrated. Honesty about failure respected. Community is tight-knit and supportive.
channel_dna.account_warmup_requirements: Create account and post a product on IH. Complete your profile with transparent metrics. Participate in forum threads for 2+ weeks before posting your own milestone content.

fit_scoring_matrix.best_product_types: SaaS products (especially solo-built), developer tools, productivity tools, content tools, niche B2B, any product built by a single founder or small team with transparent metrics
fit_scoring_matrix.worst_product_types: Enterprise software (wrong audience), physical products, services businesses, VC-funded startups (IH celebrates bootstrapping)
fit_scoring_matrix.best_pricing_models: Paid SaaS (monthly/annual) is the native model celebrated on IH. Freemium works. Enterprise contracts are less celebrated — community prefers visible MRR.
fit_scoring_matrix.icp_match_signals: Search your product category on IH forum — if threads with 20+ comments exist about your problem space, your ICP is active here.
fit_scoring_matrix.red_flags_skip_this_channel: Skip if you cannot share transparent metrics. Skip if your product is VC-funded and you are uncomfortable with bootstrapping culture. Skip if you target enterprise buyers who are not active on IH.
fit_scoring_matrix.geographic_strength: US, UK, India, Canada, Germany. Remote-first global indie founder community.

growth_mechanics.expected_cac: $0 cash. Community-driven acquisition. IH users are high-intent potential customers and collaborators.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_traffic_spike: 1-3 weeks from first milestone post. Traffic consistent but modest compared to HN or Product Hunt.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_paying_user: 2-4 weeks. IH community members are paying SaaS subscribers who try products they discover in the community.
growth_mechanics.effort_level: Low-Medium. Post monthly milestones, participate in weekly forum discussions, share honest metrics.
growth_mechanics.virality_coefficient: Low-Medium. Content rarely goes viral beyond the IH community. But IH content gets picked up by indie founder newsletters (Starter Story, MicroConf) which expands reach.
growth_mechanics.compounding_potential: Medium. Regular milestone posts build a follower base on IH. The IH interview (once you hit meaningful MRR) is a permanent piece of content that drives discovery indefinitely.

algorithm_playbook.how_reach_is_determined: Upvotes and comments on forum posts. Milestone posts with specific numbers get more engagement. Featured placement on homepage by editorial team. Newsletter inclusion (massive reach).
algorithm_playbook.what_algorithm_rewards: Transparent revenue numbers. Specific lessons learned. Honest about what failed. Engagement with other community members' posts. Regular milestone posts (monthly).
algorithm_playbook.what_kills_reach: Vague milestone posts with no numbers. Promotional posts disguised as community content. Not engaging with others' posts. Inconsistent posting (IH rewards regulars).
algorithm_playbook.peak_posting_windows: Weekday mornings (EST). First of the month for monthly milestones. Monday for maximum weekly engagement.
algorithm_playbook.optimal_posting_cadence: Monthly milestone post. Weekly forum participation (comments + questions). Quarterly longer reflection post.
algorithm_playbook.content_freshness_window: Forum posts active 48-72 hours. Milestone posts resurface when you hit new milestones. IH interviews are permanent discovery assets.

content_system.winning_content_types: 1. Monthly milestone post: '$X MRR — here is what worked and what didn't' 2. Specific question to the community 3. Resource share with genuine value 4. Launch announcement with transparent early metrics 5. Failure post ('why I shut down X — lessons learned')
content_system.hook_formulas: Milestone: 'Hit $[amount] MRR this month. Here is the single thing that made the biggest difference.' | Lesson: 'I spent 6 months building the wrong feature. Here is how I figured it out.' | Transparent failure: 'I shut down my product after 2 years. Here is everything I learned.'
content_system.platform_native_tone: Honest, transparent, metric-driven. Personal and vulnerable. Community members are peers — not an audience. Celebrate small wins. Acknowledge big losses. Numbers give posts credibility.
content_system.cta_approach: Link your IH product page to your product. Mention your product naturally in context. In forum posts: 'I built a tool for this exact problem — [product name]. Happy to share more if useful.' Do not post links without context.
content_system.content_to_avoid: Vague posts without specific numbers or lessons. Promotional posts. Bragging without substance. Not engaging with comments on your own posts. Crossing into other communities to only self-promote.
content_system.cross_posting_rules: IH milestone posts work well adapted for Twitter (build-in-public format) and LinkedIn (professional framing). The transparency of IH content is unusual on other platforms — adapt tone accordingly.

community_outreach_playbook.where_icp_clusters: IH forum by topic — look for posts about the problem your product solves. IH podcast listeners (highly engaged founders). IH newsletter subscribers.
community_outreach_playbook.contribution_before_pitch_rule: Help 10 other founders in the forum with specific, useful advice before posting about your own product. The IH community strongly rewards givers.
community_outreach_playbook.dm_outreach_approach: IH has private messaging. Reach out to founders in your adjacent space for advice, collaboration, or cross-promotion. Frame as peer-to-peer, not salesy.
community_outreach_playbook.influencer_partner_strategy: Getting a full IH interview (requires meaningful MRR — typically $1K+/month) is the most powerful thing on the platform. Reach out to Courtland Allen via IH or Twitter when you hit a milestone worth interviewing about.
community_outreach_playbook.broadcast_vs_community_mode: Community mode. IH rewards genuine participation over broadcasting. The more you contribute, the more your product gets organically mentioned.
community_outreach_playbook.banned_behaviours: Fake revenue numbers. Promotional posts disguised as community content. Spamming product links. Creating multiple accounts for upvoting.

business_stage_playbook.pre_launch_0_users: Share your idea in the IH forum — get feedback from experienced founders. Post your product even before launch to start building IH product page SEO. Join the IH community as a learner first.
business_stage_playbook.early_traction_1_to_100: First milestone post at $1 MRR (not joking — the community celebrates first dollar). Transparency about early struggles generates enormous goodwill and helpful advice.
business_stage_playbook.growth_100_to_1k: Monthly milestones with detailed lessons. Ask the community for advice on specific growth problems. Start appearing as a commenter who gives back to newcomers.
business_stage_playbook.scale_1k_plus: IH interview ($1K+ MRR is the typical threshold). Guest post on IH. Speak at MicroConf (the adjacent in-person community). Become a community pillar by helping newer founders.

proof_of_play.early_stage_win: Pieter Levels (Nomad List, Remote OK) — built his entire early audience through IH and regular transparent milestone posts. Zero ad spend. The transparency of sharing revenue numbers openly was revolutionary at the time.
proof_of_play.growth_stage_win: Bannerbear (Jack Ellis) — consistent IH milestone posts from $0 to $10K MRR drove significant signups and press. The IH interview at $10K MRR became a permanent reference for bootstrapped founders.
proof_of_play.what_made_it_work: Both shared actual numbers, actual failures, and actual lessons. The IH community trust is built on radical transparency — anything less is detected and dismissed.
proof_of_play.what_would_have_killed_it: Vague milestone posts ('Growing nicely! Excited for the future!') with no numbers or specifics would have zero engagement in a community that runs on exact MRR figures.
